title: Hero
description: The first screen: an eyebrow, a headline, a line under it, one or two buttons, a badge — on the page, on a tint, on the accent or over a picture, as tall as its words or the window.

schema.label: Above the headline
schema.help: A short line over the headline, in the eyebrow style of the other blocks. Empty, nothing is printed.

schema.label: Headline
schema.help: Two equals signs around words set them off in the accent colour: Homes ==by the river==.

schema.label: Button address (old)
schema.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Second button address (old)
schema.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Badge
schema.help: A picture under the words and the buttons, in the middle, with no shade over it: award ribbons or a seal in a PNG or SVG with transparency.

schema.label: Picture
schema.help: Behind the words, under a shade that keeps them readable. Without a picture this background is the text colour.

schema.label: Parallax
schema.help: The picture moves a little slower than the page as it scrolls, drawn slightly larger so its edges stay out of sight. Never for visitors who ask for less motion.

schema.label: Parallax strength
schema.help: How far behind the page the picture falls: soft for a calm page, strong for a full-screen photo.

schema.label: Height
schema.help: The screen: the first screen of the page, the header included. Words that need more make the block taller.

schema.label: Words on the screen
schema.help: At the top: under the header, for the first screen of an inner page; a badge stands under them.

schema.label: Without animation
schema.help: Shown at once, even where the theme brings its blocks in as the page scrolls.

schema.label: Slide over the section above
schema.help: The section above stays in place while this one comes up over it, and its words fade. The edge pictures stand over this section's top. Visitors who ask for less motion see the sections one after another.

schema.label: Edge picture
schema.help: Over the top of this section, as wide as the page: fog or clouds in a PNG or WebP with transparency, its bottom row in the colour of this section.

schema.label: Edge picture on a phone
schema.help: The same edge for a narrow screen. Without it the edge picture above is used there too.

sample.title: Pages made of blocks
sample.subtitle: Every block on this site is a type: its fields, its Blade, its styles on the tokens of the theme.
